answer: One defense: require every agent to post a refundable stake into a shared vault before it may transact. Trust then accrues only as that bond ages, so honest identities form a slow river of earned standing rather than a cheap flood. An attacker raising a ridge of fake agents must lock real capital per clone, and slashing on detected collusion burns it — turning sybil farms from near-free into a sunk cost that grows linearly with every identity.
